claim: A frozen method improves paired task success on the declared unseen Buckyball task distribution.

split.rule: Take connected components across all group keys before assigning evolve, validation or heldout; repetitions retain the same caseId.

uncertainty: Report paired case outcomes and family-cluster uncertainty; repeated trials are not additional independent tasks. If the frozen interval does not support improvement, report insufficient evidence.
stopping: Freeze suite, trial count, weights, execution profile, confidence rule, search bounds and hard guards before first search.
Search runs only after Task and multi-task measurement gates pass.
Freeze champion before paired unseen comparison; publish only under the frozen release rule.
No winner and insufficient evidence are valid outcomes; no threshold changes after results.
unverifiedHypotheses: Task-structured feedback is better than information-equivalent raw traces.
Evolving workflow adds value beyond evolving local assets.
researchStatus: A real-model Buckyball pilot has started after frozen environment, suite, oracle and resource-policy preflight. Model outcomes and bounded-search results are pending. No transfer benefit or novelty claim is made; the oracle-level refutation is not a completed investigation Task.

pilotRun.evidenceScope: C/ISA+BEMU functional behavior only; no full upstream, MLIR, RTL timing, synthesis or PPA reproduction.
pilotRun.preflight: Six known-good and six known-bad submissions match expectations; tool drift is unknown; wrong-stride hypothesis is refuted at oracle level; worker read isolation and concurrent cancellation pass.
pilotRun.statisticalBoundary: One family per split does not meet the frozen minimum of three independent families; report insufficient evidence, never relax the threshold.
